Description

This data element records the restraint equipment in use by this occupant at the time of the crash.

Notes

Prior to 2019 this data element’s name was “Restraint System/Helmet Use” that included helmet use, and the Data Element ID was P10. Starting in 2019 helmet use is captured as part of the data element “Helmet Use.”
